tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background, and the fill of buttons and selects (they sit flush with the page, set apart only by their border).

tokens.name: color
tokens.usage: All body text, labels and control text on `background` and `color-code-block` (20:1 light, 10:1 dark). Accessible dark lifts it to #d6d6d6 (13:1).

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Links, checked checkbox and radio fills, and the 3px focus ring. On `background` it is 3.4:1 in light — enough for the ring and fills, short of 4.5:1 for link text; kept exact from the source. Accessible themes: #0066cc (5.3:1 on light `background`, white tick 5.6:1) and #4da3ff (7.4:1 on dark).

tokens.name: color-primary-light
tokens.usage: Link colour while the link holds keyboard focus. 2.5:1 on light `background` (fails as text, kept exact); 7.5:1 on dark. Accessible themes: #004c99 (8:1) and #8cc4ff (10.5:1).

tokens.name: color-code-block
tokens.usage: Ground of the command block. Text on it is `color`, set in `font-mono`.

tokens.name: color-select-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of buttons and selects. 1.4:1 light / 1.6:1 dark against `background`: below the 3:1 control-border floor, kept exact from the source. Accessible themes raise it to 4.3:1 / 4.9:1, above the 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: color-checkbox-background
tokens.usage: Unchecked fill of checkboxes and radios. Low against `background` (1.4:1 / 1.5:1) — the label beside it carries the meaning. Accessible themes: 4.3:1 / 4.9:1, so an unchecked box is visible on its own.

tokens.name: color-checkbox-tick
tokens.usage: The check mark drawn on a `color-primary` checkbox (3.5:1). Accessible dark draws it in #0e0e0e, because white on the lighter #4da3ff fill would be only 2.6:1.

tokens.name: color-copy-success-background
tokens.usage: Button fill after a successful copy; its text stays `color` and changes to "Copied!".

tokens.name: color-copy-success-border
tokens.usage: Button border after a successful copy. 1.2:1 on its light fill — the label change, not the border, tells the state. Accessible themes: #1a7f37 (4.5:1) / #3fb950 (6.9:1) on their fills.

tokens.name: color-copy-fail-background
tokens.usage: Button fill when a copy failed; text stays `color` and reads "Couldn't copy :(".

tokens.name: color-copy-fail-border
tokens.usage: Button border when a copy failed (2.8:1 light, 5:1 dark on its fill). Accessible themes: #c62828 (3.9:1) / #ff6b6b (7.2:1) on their fills.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose a programming language from which you want to use the engine:
styles.usage: Every prompt, label and paragraph. The source sets one size for everything; hierarchy comes from order and controls, not type size.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Text inside buttons and selects — the same 16px as body, so controls read as part of the sentence.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Shell commands inside the command block, each line bulleted with "$ ".

tokens.name: space-control
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons, selects and the command block; gap above a control (margin-top) and right of a checkbox or radio.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Gap below each step section of the page.

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Padding around the main column.

tokens.name: space-indent
tokens.usage: Left indent of the command block and its Copy button, under the prompt that introduces them.

tokens.name: size-toggle
tokens.usage: Width and height of checkboxes and radios.

tokens.name: width-main
tokens.usage: Max width of the centred main column.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and selects — always fully rounded pills.

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Radios and the radio's inner dot.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (`:focus-visible` only) on inputs, selects and buttons; `color-primary` at 3px. Mouse focus shows no outline.
